shots.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Photoreal cinematic live-action, 16:9. Shot on ARRI Alexa Mini LF with Cooke Panchro/i Classic primes and a 1/4 Black Pro-Mist filter; 35mm for relationships, 50mm for mid shots, 85mm for faces, T2.0–T2.8 shallow depth of field. Kodak Portra 400 film emulation, about 50% teal-orange grade: teal-leaning shadows, warm amber skin. Fine film grain, soft-focus diffusion, a gentle haze in the air, soft halation on highlights, edges of the frame evenly lit. Lightly handheld throughout: a real handheld micro-shake and breathing motion. Framing stays on the people: chest- or waist-up, with headroom, hands and the key props visible in the lower frame. Real skin texture, visible pores. A warm kitchen bulb lights his hands and the glass; dusk through the window edges his grey hood. A 50mm medium shot holds steady across a scratched kitchen table in an old rental flat. A slim teenage boy in a grey hoodie sits at screen-right, watching a half-full clear glass at screen-left. Both empty hands rest on his thighs, visible below the table edge. He is the only person in the kitchen. The glass first trembles, making fine ripples across the water. As his shoulders tighten, it slides slowly rightward toward him, then rises a finger's breadth above the table. A clean strip of air remains visible beneath its base, and its transparent sides keep their ordinary warm reflections. The glass hovers with a slight sway while a bead of sweat runs down his temple and a single drop of blood reaches his upper lip. He exhales and his shoulders ease. The same glass drops the short distance back onto the table; a small splash crosses its rim. It rests upright before him as the water ripples diminish and his hands remain on his thighs. The frame remains free of subtitles, captions, title cards, and text overlays. Dialogue is audible speech only.

overall_soundscape: The refrigerator's low hum fills the small kitchen throughout the shot. A clearly heard scrape follows the glass base moving over the wooden tabletop, ending as the glass lifts. His breathing grows shallow during the hover and releases into one longer exhale as the glass returns; the refrigerator remains the steady background.

Real skin texture, visible pores. Late afternoon light filters through bamboo onto the grey robe, yellow leaves and weathered wooden gate. A 35mm medium-wide shot holds steady across an autumn courtyard in a bamboo grove. A lean, white-haired Taoist in a grey robe and wooden hairpin stands left of center. His left hand rests behind his back. Dry yellow bamboo leaves cover the paving, and an unlatched wooden gate stands closed at screen-right, hinged along its far-right post. He slowly lifts two fingers of his right hand. The leaves shiver against the paving, then rise together to knee height, leaving the stone clearly visible beneath them. They hover with gentle turns, their dry veins and curled edges catching the ordinary sunlight. His eyes shift toward the gate; only then do his two raised fingers point rightward. The hovering leaves stream toward screen-right as one low current, passing clear of his robe. The leaf current strikes the gate boards and pushes the gate outward on its right-hand hinges. It swings open and settles against its outer stop as the leaves spill through the opening. He keeps his left hand behind his back and lets his right fingers relax while the remaining leaves descend onto the paving. The frame remains free of subtitles, captions, title cards, and text overlays. Dialogue is audible speech only.

overall_soundscape: A mild wind passes through the bamboo with a soft creak from the stalks. Dry leaves rasp as they lift and gather into the rightward current, their collective rustle clearly heard as they reach the gate. The wooden gate groans on its hinges when the leaves push it outward, then gives a dull knock against its stop.

The frame remains free of subtitles, captions, title cards, and text overlays. Dialogue is audible speech only.

overall_soundscape: A low wind brushes past the cave mouth with a faint hollow resonance. shots.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Photoreal cinematic live-action, 16:9. Shot on ARRI Alexa Mini LF with Cooke Panchro/i Classic primes and a 1/4 Black Pro-Mist filter; 35mm for relationships, 50mm for mid shots, 85mm for faces, T2.0–T2.8 shallow depth of field. Kodak Portra 400 film emulation, about 50% teal-orange grade: teal-leaning shadows, warm amber skin. Fine film grain, soft-focus diffusion, a gentle haze in the air, soft halation on highlights, edges of the frame evenly lit. Lightly handheld throughout: a real handheld micro-shake and breathing motion. Framing stays on the people: chest- or waist-up, with headroom, hands and the key props visible in the lower frame. Real skin texture, visible pores. City neon reflects from the wet rooftop; a cold floodlight picks out the white shirt and falling rain. A 35mm medium-wide shot slowly pushes toward a rain-soaked rooftop railing at screen-right. A young man in a wet white shirt and black trousers stands before it, a narrow blood mark at his mouth. Three thugs approach from screen-left: one in a grey hoodie, one in a red bomber jacket and one in a navy shirt. These four occupy the rooftop. Nobody stands idle or poses for the camera. Every character is always occupied with some small piece of business — handling an object, finishing a movement, glancing at something off-topic. In every exchange one character acts while the other reacts, and reactions arrive a beat late, the way real people respond while their attention is still somewhere else. Small involuntary gestures (swallowing, shifting weight, thumb rubbing an edge, a delayed look-up) matter more than polished facial expressions. The man lowers his gaze and draws a rough breath, his hands hanging empty. His jaw tightens; when he lifts his head, a thin gold ring lights around each pupil. Rain immediately around his shoulders stops in midair, each suspended drop keeping its shape while rain beyond that small space continues falling onto the roof. His wet hair and shirt hem stream backward in a localized current. The three thugs halt their approach and take a short step back, their eyes following the gold in his face. He holds their gaze with a restrained expression as the camera draws closer. The suspended drops remain around him, the rain behind the three men keeps falling, and his shirt hem continues lifting in the air. The frame remains free of subtitles, captions, title cards, and text overlays. Dialogue is audible speech only.

overall_soundscape: Rain hits the rooftop and railing throughout, clearly continuing outside the man's small suspended pocket. His rough breath is heard before his eyes lift, followed by the scuff of the three thugs stopping and stepping back on wet concrete. A low rush of air accompanies the movement of his shirt and hair, staying beneath the surrounding rain.
